title: The Siege Plan
hints: Read TASK_BRIEF.md first — that's the work you're planning, not doing.
Name the actual files you'd touch. "I'll add rate limiting" isn't a plan; "I'll add a new middleware in src/api/middleware/ and wire it into login.js" is.

The brief says what's out of scope on purpose — a plan that quietly expands scope loses a criterion just as fast as a vague one does. And name at least one real risk or tradeoff; a plan with no downsides is hiding something.
